SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Oral Narrative (about 400 words) Poem of about 5 Stanzas, part of NATIONAL CELEBRATIONS Suggested Vocabulary: parade, guests, heroes, heroines, le in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Why is the title of a poem or a story important? 2. How do we predict events in a story or poem?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
